title: Further Done
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：further　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 further 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Further, in 1988 the fisherman explained the net at the pier, and everybody in the harbour said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the July rains the fisherman had ② further explained the net, and nobody had asked a single question. The fisherman had come to the harbour two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the harbour he had left behind him.

The logbook for July 1982 puts it plainer. The net was ③ further apart, and the boatman who kept it had ④ further landed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the harbour was ever done further in those days. The boatman wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the net at the far pier, meant something else. He explained the net ⑤ more further than anybody else in the harbour, and of all who explained it that season he explained it ⑥ the most further of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the harbour had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the logbook. What the line asked for was that the net be landed ⑦ further every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ further careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done further.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998 she explained the net ⑨ further in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Further, she said in 2000, that was the part the harbour never forgot; the logbook still speaks further of it. She kept the net in the same pier for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the harbour never forgot how further it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 进一步（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had further explained …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 进一步（修饰形容词：further apart）
C. adv. 更远（评注性状语，置于句首：Further, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 更远（修饰过去分词：had further landed it）
E. adv. 进一步（比较级 more further than：拿叔叔跟渔港里其他人相比）
F. adv. 进一步（最高级 the most further of all of them：那个汛期所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 更远（被动结构中的中位状语：be landed further）
H. adv. 更远（修饰形容词：be further careful about the whole business）

answers.why: further 意为“进一步”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Further, in 1988 …。
further 意为“进一步”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had further explained the net。
further 意为“进一步”，此处修饰形容词 apart（疏远）：was further apart。
further 意为“更远”，此处修饰过去分词 landed：had further landed it twice。
further 意为“进一步”，拿叔叔跟渔港里所有人相比，故用比较级 more further than。
further 意为“进一步”，那个汛期里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most further of all of them。
further 意为“更远”，被动结构 be landed further 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
further 意为“更远”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be further careful about the whole business。
further 意为“进一步”，1998 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次解释那件小小的渔网，副词置于动词之后。
further 意为“更远”，母亲 2000 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Further, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1988 年，渔人更远在码头解释那件小小的渔网；渔港里人人都说那是头一回。（Further, …）
雨季到来之前，渔人已经进一步解释那件小小的渔网。（had further explained …）
那件小小的渔网当时进一步疏远。（further apart）
保管它的那位船工在入冬前已经更远把它起过两回。（had further landed it）
叔叔做这件事比渔港里任何人都来得进一步。（more further than …）
在那个汛期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最进一步。（the most further of all of them）
answers: Further, in 1988 the fisherman explained the net at the pier.
Before the July rains the fisherman had further explained the net.
The boatman who kept it had further landed it twice before the winter came.
He explained the net more further than anybody else in the harbour.
Of all who did it that season, he did it the most further of all of them.

answers: Further, in 1988 the fisherman explained the net, and nobody forgot it.
